hints.title: Bit Position Difference Extraction
hints.text: The Hamming distance is the number of bit positions in which two integers differ. An exclusive disjunction identifies all differing bit positions.

hints.title: Population Count Invariant
hints.text: Taking the bitwise exclusive-or of x and y sets bits to one exactly where x and y differ, turning the problem into counting set bits.

hints.title: Bit Extraction Count Procedure
hints.text: Compute diff equal to x bitwise exclusive-or y. While diff is strictly positive, add diff bitwise and one to a count accumulator, and shift diff rightward by one. Return the count.

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(1) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting numbers to padded binary strings introduces memory allocation and slow string indexing.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitwise XOR and shift operations take at most 32 operations in O(1) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should mention XOR and Brian Kernighan bit-clearing algorithm or shift count.
